flow.name: assess_app-mcp-tool
flow.doc:name: MCP Tool: assess_app
flow.doc:description: MCP tool entry point for assessing a MuleSoft application's Java 17 upgrade readiness

mcp:tool-listener.name: assess_app
mcp:tool-listener.doc:name: MCP Tool Listener: assess_app
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:description: Assess a deployed MuleSoft application for Java 17 / Mule 4.9.x upgrade readiness. Returns the current runtime version, recommended change plan, and any warnings that require human review before submitting an upgrade job. Call this before start_upgrade.

flow.name: start_upgrade-mcp-tool
flow.doc:name: MCP Tool: start_upgrade
flow.doc:description: MCP tool entry point for submitting an approved Java 17 upgrade job

mcp:tool-listener.name: start_upgrade
mcp:tool-listener.doc:name: MCP Tool Listener: start_upgrade
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:description: Start an asynchronous Java 17 upgrade job for a MuleSoft application after the user has reviewed and approved the change plan from assess_app. Returns a jobId that can be polled with get_job_status to track progress (PROCESSING → COMMITTED → PR_OPEN → DEPLOYED).

flow.name: get_job_status-mcp-tool
flow.doc:name: MCP Tool: get_job_status
flow.doc:description: MCP tool entry point for retrieving the current status of an upgrade job

mcp:tool-listener.name: get_job_status
mcp:tool-listener.doc:name: MCP Tool Listener: get_job_status
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:description: Retrieve the current status of a platform migration job submitted by start_upgrade. Poll this tool until status reaches a terminal state: DEPLOYED (success), FAILED (error — inspect the error field), or COMMITTED (changes on branch, awaiting PR merge). When status is PR_OPEN the prUrl field contains the GitHub pull request link.

sub-flow.name: pf-assess-app
sub-flow.doc:description: Shared: assess MuleSoft app for Java 17 upgrade. Called by REST and MCP.

logger.doc:name: LOG DEBUG Assess Start
logger.message: #['LOG DEBUG | flow=pf-assess-app | correlationId=' ++ correlationId ++ ' | app=' ++ (vars.appName default 'unknown') ++ ' | env=' ++ (vars.environment default 'unknown')]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { appName: vars.appName, currentRuntime: "4.6.9", currentJavaVersion: "8", changePlan: { targetRuntime: "4.9.18", targetJavaVersion: "17", filesToChange: [ "pom.xml", "src/main/mule/global-config.xml" ], hasApiPolicies: false, hasCustomJavaCode: false, hasLookupFunction: false }, warnings: [ "Assessment is running in placeholder mode. Integrate with Anypoint ARM API for live data." ] }

logger.doc:name: LOG DEBUG Assess Complete
logger.message: #['LOG DEBUG | flow=pf-assess-app | correlationId=' ++ correlationId ++ ' | assessment complete for app=' ++ vars.appName]

sub-flow.name: pf-start-upgrade
sub-flow.doc:description: Shared: generate jobId, store in Object Store, return jobId. Called by REST and MCP.

logger.doc:name: LOG DEBUG Upgrade Start
logger.message: #['LOG DEBUG | flow=pf-start-upgrade | correlationId=' ++ correlationId ++ ' | app=' ++ (vars.appName default 'unknown')]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { jobId: vars.jobId, status: "PROCESSING", appName: vars.appName, environment: vars.environment, jiraTicketId: vars.jiraTicketId, approvedChangePlan: vars.approvedChangePlan, createdAt: now() as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'"}, prUrl: null, branchName: null, completedAt: null, error: null }

logger.doc:name: LOG INFO Job Created
logger.message: #['LOG INFO | flow=pf-start-upgrade | correlationId=' ++ correlationId ++ ' | jobId=' ++ vars.jobId ++ ' | status=PROCESSING | app=' ++ vars.appName]

sub-flow.name: pf-get-job-status
sub-flow.doc:description: Shared: retrieve job from Object Store by jobId. Called by REST and MCP.

logger.doc:name: LOG DEBUG Status Lookup
logger.message: #['LOG DEBUG | flow=pf-get-job-status | correlationId=' ++ correlationId ++ ' | jobId=' ++ (vars.jobId default 'unknown')]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { jobId: payload.jobId, status: payload.status } ++ (if (payload.branchName != null) { branchName: payload.branchName } else {}) ++ (if (payload.prUrl != null) { prUrl: payload.prUrl } else {}) ++ (if (payload.completedAt != null){ completedAt: payload.completedAt } else {}) ++ (if (payload.error != null) { error: payload.error } else {})

logger.doc:name: LOG DEBUG Status Found
logger.message: #['LOG DEBUG | flow=pf-get-job-status | correlationId=' ++ correlationId ++ ' | jobId=' ++ vars.jobId ++ ' | status=' ++ payload.status]
